message.subject: Last chance: registration ends today!
message.excerpt: Registration closes today. Sign in to your account to save your spot (offer 12161): https://bit.ly/2f81

findings.title: Asks you to sign in, and fast
evidence: Wording asks for credentials under pressure: "sign in"; "last chance"
findings.lesson: Pressure plus a login request is the classic pairing. Pause, then go to the site on your own.

findings.title: Replies go to a different domain
evidence: From eastport[.]example but replies go to mailer-eastport[.]example
findings.lesson: Look at where a reply would actually land. If it isn't the sender's own domain, the person writing may not be who they say.

findings.title: Link is shortened
evidence: Shortened link via bit[.]ly could not be resolved without visiting it
findings.lesson: Short links hide where they lead. If you weren't expecting one, don't open it.
